component.name: DeepCool Digital
component.summary: Control the DeepCool DIGITAL cooler display

description.p: Tray application and systemd services for DeepCool DIGITAL coolers (e.g. AK620 DIGITAL / DIGITAL SE) on Linux, replicating the DeepCool Digital Windows software.

Shows CPU temperature and usage on the cooler display, with Temperature / Usage / Auto / Smart (load-aware) modes, °C/°F, over temperature alarm, configurable refresh and alternation intervals, and login autostart.
